description: Test helper functions and mocks for the fs-bridge module in a sandbox environment, including mock setups for Docker interactions, filesystem operations, and test fixture creation.

methods.name: loadFreshFsBridgeModuleForTest
methods.description: Reloads the fs-bridge module with mocks for testing.

methods.name: createSandboxFsBridge
methods.description: Creates a sandbox filesystem bridge with optional arguments.

methods.name: createSeededSandboxFsBridge
methods.description: Sets up a sandbox filesystem with specified files and contents.

methods.name: withTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory, runs a callback, then cleans up.

methods.name: installDockerReadMock
methods.description: Mocks Docker command responses for filesystem operations.

methods.name: createHostEscapeFixture
methods.description: Creates a fixture with directories and a secret file outside the sandbox.

methods.name: expectMkdirpAllowsExistingDirectory
methods.description: Tests mkdirp behavior allowing existing directories with optional boundary fallback.

methods.name: installFsBridgeTestHarness
methods.description: Sets up test environment with mocks and resets before each test.
